about_the_game:
Your views are dropping, your followers are vanishing and your relevance is almost non-existent. So doing what a desperate influencer would do, you just go to the middle of nowhere and explore a seemingly abandoned house.

This HAS to be the perfect setup for a viral video. You've got a whole place to yourself so you setup your cameras to create the set piece. Surely this has to be the perfect place for this video.

But as the sun sets, the doors swing open, and you realize you’re no longer alone.

Survive the night... or surrender to the attention they so desperately want.

Surviving the night

Using your cameras that you setup, you need to keep a track of all the girls coming to get you:

  • Starburst the Futa - She loves her attention, so she always wants you to be watching her else you might find that she wants you instead.

  • Wylde the Catgirl - They say a watched pot never boils, you can also apply this same concept to Wylde as she freezes up whilst you're watching her.

  • Luci the Succubus - Being a demon from hell, she's practically impossible to see on your cameras. Luckily, Luci loves to make her presence known with her chuckles.

  • Rosana the MILF - She loves making herself known with her adverts, get rid of them as soon as you can otherwise you may lose track of everyone else.

Custom Night

Having known you for a while, the girls have invited you to stay a little longer to play. The custom night allows you to configure their difficulty as well as adding other difficulty options not seen in the base game.
